setup.title: Welcome to Glean
setup.subtitle: Let's connect to your backend server
setup.intro: Glean is a self-hosted RSS reader. This desktop app is a client that connects to a backend server you run on your own machine or server. Let's get it set up.
setup.architectureDesc: The Glean backend stores your subscriptions, articles, and bookmarks. This client talks to that backend over your network. You only need to set this up once.
setup.deployDesc: Run the official Docker image on any machine with Docker installed. This starts the API, worker, database, and web frontend together.
setup.deployAfterRun: After starting, the backend is available at
setup.deployDefaultCreds: A default admin account is created automatically (admin / Admin123!). Change it after first login.
setup.connectDesc: Enter the backend URL below and test the connection. The default is http://localhost:8000 if you deployed locally.
setup.connected: Connected successfully! Taking you to sign in...
setup.skipToLogin: I already have a server — take me to sign in
setup.webUnavailableDesc: The server may be down or starting up. Please verify the backend is running and reload.
setup.errorUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Make sure it's running and the URL is correct.
setup.errorInvalid: Please enter a valid URL (e.g., http://localhost:8000).
setup.errorMalformed: Server responded, but not like a Glean backend. Check the URL.
setup.errorSave: Failed to save the server URL.
setup.insecureConnection: HTTP connection — fine for localhost, not recommended for remote servers.
